description: This PHP source file defines the InstallController class for the Revive Adserver project. It manages the installation and upgrade process through various actions such as checking environment, configuring settings, database setup, and finalizing installation. It includes methods for handling user input, session management, and orchestrating the installation wizard flow.

classes.name: OX_Admin_UI_Install_InstallController
classes.description: Controller class managing the installation and upgrade process of Revive Adserver, including environment checks, configuration, database setup, recovery, and finalization steps.

methods.name: getRegisteredActions
methods.description: Returns a list of supported actions for the controller.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the controller, loads language files, sets up upgrader and session, and handles recovery logic.

methods.name: initUpgrader
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the OA_Upgrade class.

methods.name: initInstallStatus
methods.description: Initializes the installation status, resetting if recovery or upgrade is required.

methods.name: initStepConfig
methods.description: Sets up session flags for login and configuration steps based on plugin verification.

methods.name: initModel
methods.description: Sets the page header based on current installation status.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Redirects to restart step if user accesses index directly.

methods.name: checkAction
methods.description: Performs environment checks, verifies upgrade possibilities, and determines if user can proceed.

methods.name: welcomeAction
methods.description: Displays the welcome step of the installer, proceeding on user confirmation.

methods.name: loginAction
methods.description: Handles admin login during installation, validating credentials.

methods.name: databaseAction
methods.description: Manages database configuration, installation, or upgrade based on user input.

methods.name: configurationAction
methods.description: Handles application configuration, including language, timezone, and plugin verification.

methods.name: jobsAction
methods.description: Displays and manages background jobs during installation or upgrade.

methods.name: finishAction
methods.description: Finalizes installation, marks system as installed, and cleans up.

methods.name: uptodateAction
methods.description: Handles post-upgrade steps when system is up-to-date.

methods.name: recoveryAction
methods.description: Manages recovery process if upgrade was interrupted or failed.

methods.name: errorAction
methods.description: Displays errors encountered during upgrade or installation.

methods.name: restartAction
methods.description: Resets the installer and restarts the wizard flow.

methods.name: finalizeInstallation
methods.description: Marks the system as installed and removes upgrade files.

methods.name: resetInstaller
methods.description: Resets the wizard, session, and internal state.

methods.name: setCurrentStepIfReachable
methods.description: Sets the current wizard step if it is reachable and accessible.

methods.name: processDatabaseAction
methods.description: Performs database installation or upgrade based on form data.

methods.name: processConfigurationAction
methods.description: Saves configuration, admin credentials, and handles plugin import during setup.

methods.name: getUpgrader
methods.description: Returns the internal OA_Upgrade instance.

methods.name: getInstallStatus
methods.description: Returns the current installation status object.

methods.name: abortInstall
methods.description: Redirects to index.php to abort installation.
